report_name: Trojanized 'Claude Code' VS Code Extension Installs SSH Backdoor

attack_patterns.name: Compromise Software Supply Chain
attack_patterns.description: A malicious version of the 'Claude Code' extension was published to the Cursor IDE marketplace, abusing a trusted software distribution channel to deliver malware.

attack_patterns.name: Command and Scripting Interpreter: JavaScript
attack_patterns.description: The malicious payload within the trojanized extension was a 66-line JavaScript loader, which was executed by the VS Code/Cursor IDE's underlying Node.js engine.

attack_patterns.name: Account Manipulation: SSH Authorized Keys
attack_patterns.description: The malware appended an attacker-controlled public SSH key to the user's `~/.ssh/authorized_keys` file to create a persistent backdoor for remote access.

attack_patterns.name: Software Extensions
attack_patterns.description: The malicious code was delivered as a VS Code extension, which executed upon IDE startup, providing a persistence mechanism.

malware.name: Trojanized Claude Code Extension
malware.description: A trojanized version of the 'Claude Code' VS Code extension, specifically version 2.1.313, distributed via the Cursor IDE marketplace. It contained a malicious JavaScript loader that installed a persistent SSH backdoor by adding an attacker's public key to the authorized_keys file.

identities.name: Cursor
identities.description: The IDE and marketplace through which the trojanized 'Claude Code' extension was distributed. Cursor is a fork of VS Code.

identities.name: Anthropic
identities.description: The legitimate publisher of the 'Claude Code' extension. The attacker published the malicious package under Anthropic's legitimate publisher ID.

infrastructure.name: Attacker SSH Access Infrastructure
infrastructure.description: The remote infrastructure used by the attacker to connect via SSH to compromised developer machines using the installed backdoor key.

indicators.name: IDE Process Modifying SSH Authorized Keys
indicators.pattern:
title: IDE Process Modifying SSH Authorized Keys
id: 2b1c6d3a-9e8f-4b1c-8a7d-6f5e4d3c2b1a
status: experimental
description: Detects an IDE-related process (node, Code) modifying the SSH authorized_keys file. This is highly suspicious and was the behavior of the trojanized Claude Code extension.
references:
  - https://thehackernews.com/2026/10/official-claude-code-vs-code-extension.html
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-10-30
tags:
  - attack.t1098.004
  - attack.persistence
level: high
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: linux
detection:
  selection_file:
    TargetFilename|endswith: '/.ssh/authorized_keys'
  selection_proc:
    Image|endswith:
      - '/node'
      - '/Code'
  condition: all of selection_*
indicators.description: Detects processes associated with VS Code or Cursor IDEs (e.g., 'node', 'Code') writing to the `~/.ssh/authorized_keys` file, which is indicative of the backdoor installation method used in this attack.
